library.title: Library
library.empty: No courses yet. Add a course from a local folder.

scriptWarning.title: This course will run scripts
scriptWarning.text: A course runs its scripts on your computer with your permissions. Add it only if you trust its author.

errors.manifestMissing: The course has no course.yaml in its root.
errors.unsupportedSchemaVersion: course.yaml uses schema version {version}, which requires a newer version of the app.
errors.yamlSyntax: course.yaml is not valid YAML near line {line}.
errors.invalidSlug: “{value}” is not a valid slug: use lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
errors.emptyList: the list must not be empty
errors.emptyString: the value must not be empty
errors.duplicateSectionSlug: section slug “{slug}” is used more than once
errors.duplicateActivitySlug: activity slug “{slug}” is used more than once in the course
errors.pathInvalid: path “{path}” must be relative, use / as separator and not contain ..
errors.pathNotFound: file “{path}” does not exist in the course
errors.overviewFileAmbiguous: The course has several overview files: {files}. Keep only one.
errors.courseReadFailed: Could not read “{path}” in the course.
errors.storageKeyTaken: Storage key {key} is already used by {source}.
errors.courseNotFound: Course {key} is not in the library.
errors.copyFailed: Could not copy the course from “{path}”.
errors.libraryNewerFormat: The library was saved by a newer version of the app. Update the app to use it.
errors.notEnrolled: You are not enrolled in this course.
errors.progressReadFailed: Could not read the course progress.
errors.progressWriteFailed: Could not save the course progress.
errors.internal: Unexpected error. Details are in the log.
